newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Stride Rite raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Stride Rite raised.

text.p: -- Morgan Stanley said it upgraded Stride Rite Corp to strong buy from neutral.
-- said believes Stride Rite's "long awaited turnaround is underway."
-- expects Stride Rite to earn $13 million or $0.26 a share on revenues of $490 million in 1997.
-- expects sales to grow 14 percent annually over the next three years and earnings to expand 15-fold to $37.6 million by 1999.
-- said believes the Keds brand has bottomed and the obsolete inventories at the Keds division have been cleared up.
-- cited company has more focused, product and marketing driven management team in all four major divisions.
-- said the launch of Tommy Hilfiger Corp footwear has seen early success at retail stores.
-- said Stride Rite has a strong balance sheet with 0.3 percent total debt to capital.
-- said company has longer term opportunities in licensing.
